svg.title: AWS Ktor SQS Plugin Sequence
svg.desc: Ktor lifecycle starts SQS pollers, route handlers publish messages, consumers ack or retry, and shutdown closes clients.
svg.text: Ktor lifecycle starts SQS pollers, route handlers publish messages, consumers ack or retry, and shutdown closes clients.

g.text: else handler failed: keep message visible
Ktor plugin coordinates lifecycle and polling; application code owns handlers and retry policy.
